title: Arrowhead Pointe
gap: Age minimum not explicitly stated for general play
blurb: Arrowhead Pointe is a Bob Walker designed 18-hole golf course nestled in the Northeast Georgia mountains. Ten of the holes skirt the shoreline of Lake Richard B. Russell, offering challenging elevation changes, doglegs, and well-placed bunkers. The course features Tifeagle Bermuda greens with subtle breaks and a newly renovated café and golf shop.
hoursText: Open daily except Christmas Day. 7 a.m.–10 p.m.
